products.title: Vase Primates Brazza - Glossy Chic Pink
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Primates Brazza Vase is a decorative vase by Italian ceramic brand Bosa. Available in three different designs, the vase is hand-painted with colours from Bosa's own colour palette. Primates Brazza Vase is made of high-quality ceramic, decorative metals and is glazed. It was designed by Elena Salmistraro in 2017 and belongs to the Primates collection. The design language of the vase is creative, dynamic and inspired by the markatta of the monkey genus Brazza.The collection is designed to remind us of the relationship between humans and our closest relative, the monkey. With the design, Elena Salmistraro aims to reflect on similarities in body language, facial expressions and movement. The first collection was shown in 2017 at Maison&Objet and included vases. The inspiration for the design comes from three different monkey genera, the mandrill, the golden markatta and the brazzas markatta. The elegant vases fit equally well on a table and a sideboard and are a decorative interior detail.

Width: 25.5 cm
Height: 40 cm
Depth: 25.5 cm
Weight: 3.4 kg

products.title: Hopebird - Glossy Gold
products.description_html: Hope Bird is a sculpture by Italian ceramic brand Bosa and comes in several designs. Designed by Jaime Hayon in 2013, the sculpture is part of the Hope Bird collection. Hope Bird is made of high-quality ceramics, decorative metals and is hand-painted by artists. The sculpture is glazed and gives an elegant look. The design language is creative and decorative.Hope Bird symbolises an optimistic view of the future. The sculpture stands tall and proud with a dynamic posture, looking towards the horizon. Jaime Hayon wants to remind us to look forward and take a cheerful view of what the future has to offer. Hope Bird is a decorative piece of furniture that fits well on a chest of drawers or on a shelf and should spread a positive atmosphere in the home.

This stunning edition of the famous Sisters Collection consists of five sculptures vases made of white ceramic. Their names are Louise, Frida, Sofia, Helen and Clara, they are sisters. Imaginative, happy and caring.
